edit.ability:
When any creature dies, gain souls equal to their max HP.
(1CD)(2U) May use souls to summon non-soul yielding minions onto any creature:
(4 souls) Red Bloon
(12 souls) Ceramic Bloon
(24 souls) M.O.A.B.
(36 souls) B.F.B.
